sample_unit: expert assessments per chatbot per domain (12 responses x 8 experts)

links.outcome: Rate of incorrect, partially correct, or misleading chatbot answers to patient questions on 177Lu-PSMA-617 therapy
links.effect: Experts rated responses incorrect or partially correct at 16.6% for ChatGPT-4 and 29.1% for Bard. Bard's answers had significantly more misleading information than ChatGPT-4 (p=0.039).
links.quote: Experts categorized the AI-generated responses as incorrect or partially correct at a rate of 16.6% for ChatGPT-4 and 29.1% for Bard.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, conciseness, and readability of ChatGPT-4 and Bard responses to common patient questions regarding prostate cancer therapy without testing any deployment safeguards or practices.
